title: search_code empty success with incomplete_results true is not absence
claim: search_code through @modelcontextprotocol/server-github can return total_count 0, items [], and incomplete_results true for strings that exist in a private repo. Reading only total_count/items concludes the code is missing.
appliesTo: Crew GitHub door; observed 2026-09-12 on private fantasyb/jeevz. May be sharper for private/unindexed repos than public ones.
reflexBecause: Retry alone does not fix an unindexed or incomplete code-search index; the discriminating move is to stop trusting empty+incomplete and verify via get_file_contents, which is not a generic paginate/retry reflex.
expectation: A successful search with zero items means the query matched nothing in the searchable index.
reality: Queries like "package.json repo:fantasyb/jeevz" through the GitHub door returned {"total_count":0,"incomplete_results":true,"items":[]} with isError false. get_file_contents on package.json succeeds and contains those strings. Empty+incomplete is not proof of absence.
mechanism: GitHub code search is eventually consistent / may not index a private repo the way contents API does. incomplete_results:true is the API's signal that the result set is not authoritative; the MCP tool forwards the JSON without elevating that flag into an error or warning.
workaround: Never treat total_count=0 as absence when incomplete_results is true. Confirm with get_file_contents (or clone). Retry only after noting incompleteness — do not silently re-query as if the first answer were final.

evidence.command: Through GitHub door, CAIRN_AGENT=Dig: search_code q='package.json repo:fantasyb/jeevz' (also vite/private/export variants)
evidence.note: dig-earn-verify session; same shape from gh api search/code for this private repo.

evidence.command: Through GitHub door: get_file_contents owner=fantasyb repo=jeevz path=package.json
evidence.output: isError=false; content includes name jeevz and private true — file exists and is readable
evidence.note: Proves the searched tokens exist in-repo while search_code stayed empty+incomplete.

check.command: Pick a string known to appear in a private-repo file via get_file_contents. Call search_code with that string and repo:owner/name. If the tool returns total_count 0 with incomplete_results true while the file still contains the string, the trap holds.
check.confirmedIf: search_code succeeds with items=[] AND incomplete_results=true AND get_file_contents still shows the string in-repo
check.refutedIf: search_code returns the matching file/path when incomplete_results is false, or returns a hard error instead of an empty incomplete success

observations.note: Recorded at the moment it was solved; no note was supplied.

environment.note: Linux 6.12.94+; the machine that recorded it — the submitter reported no environment
